// ==========================================
// SEJR ARCANA MODULE (for the Sejr fork of the Shadowdark generator)
// LISTS PANEL: replace your old other_arcanum list with everything below.
// It uses d(n) and sec(title, body), which the fork already defines.
// Generated by tools/build_perchance.py from data/sejr_arcana.json. Edit the JSON, not this file.
// ==========================================

// Faces 1-20 of the level 1 draw. Every hero draws from these.
other_arcanum
  The Drowning Scale
  The Hourglass of Borrowed Time
  The Black Lotus Case
  The Oath-Band
  The Unpaid Favor
  The Valkyrie's Feather
  The Hellhide
  The Kettle Plate
  The Fairy Jar
  The Apology Blade
  The Rune Fragment
  The Binding Linens
  The Rusted Spear
  The Derelict Harpoon
  The Seekers' Provenance Ledger
  The Black Goat's Tally-Stick
  The Gate Chain
  The Sown Teeth
  The Hut on Hen's Legs
  The Crafter's Codex

// Faces 21-23: the three strongest, reached only with a legacy bonus
// (+1 for each of the player's heroes who died, retired or was lost to an Escalation, max +3).
legacy_arcanum_top
  The Hexing Needles
  The Bear-Lodge Horn
  The Axe of Nine Eyes

// d20 + bonus on the ordered draw. legacy_arcanum(0) never reaches 21-23.
legacy_arcanum(bonus) =>
  let roll = Math.min(d(20) + Math.min(bonus || 0, 3), 23);
  return roll <= 20 ? String(other_arcanum.selectAll[roll - 1]) : String(legacy_arcanum_top.selectAll[roll - 21]);

// Faction rewards: never rolled at hero creation. The GM hands these out in play.
// Class arcana are here too; class_arcanum_name()[cls] finds a hero's own.
faction_reward_arcanum
  The Ancestor's Knucklebone
  The Loaded Die
  The Battle Standard of the Nameless King
  The Borderlands Tracking Cord
  The Cracked Lens of Kartan
  The Broken Verdict
  The Hollow Contract
  The Bell of the Three Sisters
  The Theater of Whispers Setlist
  Mud from the Revlend Marshes
  The Pain Teacher's Wrappings
  The Forgotten Key
  The Tide-Coat
  The Pitch-Sap Harness
  The Seven-Leaf Bracelet
  The Arch-Watch Mirror

// Class name (as in hero_class) to its class arcanum.
class_arcanum_name() =>
  return {
  "Berserker": "The Ancestor's Knucklebone",
  "Cheat": "The Loaded Die",
  "Commander": "The Battle Standard of the Nameless King",
  "Hunter": "The Borderlands Tracking Cord",
  "Mage": "The Cracked Lens of Kartan",
  "Oathsworn": "The Broken Verdict",
  "Shadowmancer": "The Hollow Contract",
  "Shepherd": "The Bell of the Three Sisters",
  "Songweaver": "The Theater of Whispers Setlist",
  "Stormshifter": "Mud from the Revlend Marshes",
  "Zephyr": "The Pain Teacher's Wrappings"
  };

guild_option(cls) =>
  let g = guild_data()[cls];
  if (!g) return "";
  let card = "<p><b>Master:</b> " + g.master + "</p><p><b>Wants:</b> " + g.wants + "</p><p><b>Teeth:</b> " + g.teeth + "</p><p><b>Keeps:</b> " + g.keeps + "</p><p><b>Split:</b> " + g.split + "</p><p><b>Journeyman reward:</b> " + g.arcanum + ": " + g.gives + "</p><p><b>Rival:</b> " + g.rival + "</p>";
  return "<p><b>Or, instead of the holding, a guild:</b> " + g.name + ", at " + g.hall + ". Teaches " + g.teaches + ". Asks " + g.asks + ".</p><details><summary>GM: guild card</summary>" + card + "</details>";

// Player sees the object. GM opens the fold. Ritual boxes are for absent-player ticks.
arcanum_line(name) =>
  let a = arcana_data()[name];
  if (!a) return "<p><b>Arcanum:</b> " + name + ", unexamined.</p>";
  let boxes = a.unlock.map(u => "<li>&#9744; " + u + "</li>").join("");
  let g = "<ul>" + boxes + "</ul>";
  if (a.risk) g += "<p><b>Risk:</b> " + a.risk + "</p>";
  if (a.res) g += "<p><b>Resource:</b> " + a.res + "</p>";
  if (a.power) g += "<p><b>Power:</b> " + a.power + "</p>";
  if (a.esc) g += "<p><b>Escalation:</b> " + a.esc + "</p>";
  if (a.table) g += "<p><b>" + a.table.title + " (d6):</b> " + a.table.rows.map((r, i) => (i + 1) + " " + r).join("; ") + ".</p>";
  g += "<p><b>Examine:</b> " + forge_clue.evaluateItem + "</p>";
  return "<p><b>Arcanum:</b> " + name + " (" + a.tier + "), unexamined. " + a.obj + "</p><details><summary>GM: ritual and powers</summary>" + g + "</details>";

// ---------- FORGED ARCANA (random, from the mined tables) ----------

forge_object
  a carved bone that catches fire once a day
  a wolf idol that floats wherever it is set down
  a dried rose that turns toward the nearest arch
  a cold iron spike that smells of poison near poison
  a warped skull that drips blood near the dead
  a cracked mirror that sings a lullaby when rattled
  a severed finger whose owner wants it back
  a black candle that fey cannot stand
  a ring of daisies that never wilts
  a faded locket that is warm when someone lies
  a shard of blue glass that shows brief portents
  a bronze oil lamp with a faded inscription
  a jade comb that once pardoned a crime
  a torn half of a map, the other half somewhere in the city
  a silver lion on a braided chain, taken in a raid
  a gold rose dotted with rubies, from a sacked chapel
  a coffer of coins stamped with a dead king's face
  a rusted compass whose needle draws blood
  a stick of damp chalk
  a pair of glass eyes in a velvet case
  a lantern shield with a cracked lens
  a skin-stretched shield, light as a basket
  a chain-scythe wrapped in prayer cloth
  a sun-and-moon blade with one edge dulled
  a fighting fan with names painted on the ribs
  a jitte that catches more than blades
  a speargun built for a hand that wasn't human
  a chakram that never quite stops spinning
  a war rake from a peasant army that won
  a coat of overlapping coins, half of them forged

forge_material
  bone, light and brittle, and the dead notice it
  bronze, old and green, and older than the city
  coral, still growing
  obsidian, sharp enough to cut shadows
  red steel, light and hot to the touch
  petrified wood that remembers being a tree
  silver, soft but feared
  dragon, and the dragon's kin can smell it
  gold, too heavy to be practical, and everyone wants it
  crystal that rings when danger is near

forge_amulet_material
  bone
  copper
  crystal
  obsidian
  cloudy gemstone
  tarnished silver
  ice that never melts
  cold iron
  platinum
  solid shadow
  black wood

forge_amulet_shape
  bar
  diamond
  disc
  hand
  hexagon
  jagged shard
  octagon
  ring
  saint's effigy
  teardrop
  twisted knot

forge_amulet_engraving
  star signs
  a coiled wyrm
  an open eye
  a leaf-faced man
  a griffon
  a leering face
  sigils no one can read
  a magic square
  sun and moon
  runes
  a skull wound with roses

forge_element
  void
  death and darkness
  fire, metal and smoke
  earth, stone and root
  water, ice and mist
  air, wind and storm
  life and light
  stars

forge_magic
  necromancy
  destruction
  summoning
  glamour
  artifice
  transformation
  warding and binding
  healing
  divination

forge_quirk
  Fires within a few steps of you gutter and die.
  Animals bristle at you and won't come close.
  You have no sense of smell while it is on you.
  People near you sleep badly.
  Holy water goes flat in your presence.
  Gems you touch cloud over.
  Cut flowers wilt in your hands.
  You smell faintly of something wrong.
  You can't see well when it is more than a few steps away.
  Spells find you easily: disadvantage on saves against magic.

forge_clue
  Roll d6 when someone examines it. 1 where it was last seen. 2 when it was last seen. 3 a story about someone who used it. 4 a book or sage who knows of it. 5 who made it, or how it came to be. 6 one of its powers.

forge_source
  a book in a dead language
  an Archkeeper who wants something in return
  the ghost of its last owner
  a riddle carved on its own surface
  a hermit who claims to have made it
  a song nobody sings anymore
  a rival who already knows, and is ahead of you
  the command word, lost; only a sage or divination will find it

forge_resource
  Breath
  Debt
  Hunger
  Heat
  Strain
  Sand
  Tally
  Silence
  Ash
  Blood

forge_refill
  regain all at a Safe Rest spent where the object was made
  regain 1 when you give something you love to a stranger
  regain 1 when you tell someone a true secret about yourself
  regain all after a whole night spent in a grave, a tomb or a cistern, not passing through
  regain 1 when you keep a promise that costs you
  regain 1 when someone else freely bleeds on it
  it never refills, and it is spent for good

forge_power
  Reaction, 1 RES: when an ally within 6 spaces is hit, take the hit instead and halve it
  Action, 1 RES: one creature you can see is Frightened until the end of its next turn, WIL DC 13 negates
  Action, 1 RES: ask the GM one question about the place you stand; the answer is true
  Free, 1 RES, 1/round: teleport to a spot you can see within 4 spaces
  Action, 1 RES: an object you touch is unbreakable for an hour
  Reaction, 1 RES: reroll one of your own dice; keep the new result
  Action, 1 RES: for one minute you see in total darkness and spot the invisible
  Action, 1 RES: speak with the dead body you touch, three questions

forge_escalation
  The object chooses a champion. It starts to change your body to keep itself safe; the GM names one change each time it empties.
  Something has been following the object for a long time. When it empties, it arrives, and it can look like anyone.
  Your fingertips blacken. Each time it empties, the black climbs higher, and it grants one boon and one oddity.
  It stores your pain. When it empties, take every Wound you avoided since you last emptied it.
  You stop aging. When it empties, a year catches up with you all at once.
  It goes silent for a season. What it knows is locked away until a ritual wakes it.
  It shatters, and the shards go into your flesh. You keep the power, and it keeps you.
  You are branded. Those who carry arcana of their own can see the mark.
  You can't bring yourself to put it down. If it is taken, you will hunt for it.
  It must be fed each week. Miss a week, and it feeds on whoever is closest.
  It gets heavier after every fight, until you shed what it has caught.
  Water undoes it. A soaking costs it 1 RES, and it can't be used while wet.
  An order that hates its kind attacks you on sight.

forge_unlock
  return it to the place it was made
  learn its maker's name from someone who would rather not say
  spend a full night with it at an arch
  carry it through the Lower Reaches without light
  get an Archkeeper to write it in the records
  bury it for three days and dig it up yourself
  let a stranger hold it and tell you what they see

forge_risk
  something comes through before you can close the way
  STR DC 14 or take 1 Wound from the backlash
  it marks you instead, and you have a week before it comes calling
  it cracks, and only a skilled artisan can mend it before it wakes
  a faction notices, and its clock ticks

forged_arcanum() =>
  let res = forge_resource.evaluateItem;
  let max = [3, 3, 4, 5][d(4) - 1];
  let u1 = forge_unlock.evaluateItem;
  let u2 = forge_unlock.evaluateItem;
  while (u2 === u1) { u2 = forge_unlock.evaluateItem; }
  let obj = forge_object.evaluateItem;
  let r = d(4);
  if (r === 1) obj = obj + ", made of " + forge_material.evaluateItem;
  if (r === 2) obj = "an amulet of " + forge_amulet_material.evaluateItem + ", shaped like a " + forge_amulet_shape.evaluateItem + ", engraved with " + forge_amulet_engraving.evaluateItem;
  let b = "<p class='hook'>" + obj + "</p>";
  b += "<p><b>Nature:</b> " + forge_magic.evaluateItem + ", of " + forge_element.evaluateItem + ".</p>";
  b += "<p><b>Lore lives in:</b> " + forge_source.evaluateItem + ".</p>";
  b += "<p><b>Ritual:</b></p><ul><li>&#9744; " + u1 + "</li><li>&#9744; " + u2 + "</li></ul>";
  b += "<p><b>Risk:</b> " + forge_risk.evaluateItem + ".</p>";
  b += "<p><b>Resource:</b> " + res + " (" + max + "), " + forge_refill.evaluateItem + ".</p>";
  b += "<p><b>Power:</b> " + forge_power.evaluateItem.replace("RES", res) + ".</p>";
  b += "<p><b>Quirk (always on):</b> " + forge_quirk.evaluateItem + "</p>";
  b += "<p><b>Escalation:</b> " + forge_escalation.evaluateItem.replace("RES", res) + "</p>";
  b += "<p><b>Examine:</b> " + forge_clue.evaluateItem + "</p>";
  b += "<p class='close'>Name it in play. Check it against the design rules before it reaches the table.</p>";
  return sec("Forged arcanum", b);

curated_arcanum() =>
  return sec("Arcanum", arcanum_line(other_arcanum.evaluateItem));

// ==========================================
// HTML PANEL: add next to your other buttons
// <button onclick="arcOut.innerHTML = curated_arcanum()">Roll an arcanum</button>
// <button onclick="arcOut.innerHTML = forged_arcanum()">Forge an arcanum</button>
// <div id="arcOut"></div>
// ==========================================
